start: Exercise library, member taps create (screen 'New exercise')

user_sees: The name; muscle and equipment may be guessed from the name until the member picks them
must_not: A guess overwriting a field the member already picked

steps.action: Pick 'Main muscle' and 'Equipment'; leave 'How you log it' as weight and reps
user_sees: The pinned button changes from the missing-field words to 'Save exercise'
must_not: Save tappable while name, muscle or equipment is empty

user_sees: The new exercise's page
must_not: Two copies from a double tap; the exercise missing from the library

start: Active workout, exercise picker; member ticks two exercises then taps create

user_sees: Button 'Save and add to workout'
must_not: The ticked exercises forgotten

user_sees: Back in the workout with the two ticked exercises and the new one added
must_not: The new exercise saved but not added; the picker left open over the workout

start: A routine's 'Add exercise' picker; member creates a new exercise

user_sees: Back on the routine with the exercise added
must_not: The routine left without it and no word

user_sees: 'Saved, but not added' — '<name> is in your library. Add it to the routine from "Add exercise".'
must_not: The exercise lost, or a success with nothing added

start: Library exercise page; member hides it, then opens Hidden exercises

steps.action: Hide a library exercise from its page
user_sees: It disappears from every exercise list
must_not: It still showing in the workout picker

user_sees: Subtitle 'Hidden from every exercise list. Show one to bring it back.' and the exercise with 'Show'
must_not: A blank list while something is hidden

user_sees: It leaves this list and comes back in every list
must_not: Past sets of that exercise lost or changed

start: New exercise, name typed is the same as one already there ('bench press' vs 'Bench Press')

user_sees: Pop-up 'Already in your library' — '"Bench Press" already exists.' with 'Open it'
must_not: A second exercise with the same name

user_sees: The existing exercise's page
must_not: A new exercise made anyway

steps.action: Edit an exercise whose data cannot be read
user_sees: A load error; nothing saves
must_not: The edit saved as a new exercise

start: Free plan limit on own exercises switched on (switched off at launch); member at the limit

user_sees: An explanation of the free limit with a way to MettleUp Plus
must_not: The exercise saved over the limit; a gym member (free Plus) refused

steps.action: Come back from the Plus screen without buying
user_sees: The form as typed, Save usable again
must_not: Save stuck on its busy spinner

start: Own exercise 'Landmine Press' with 10 logged sets

steps.action: Open it, tap edit; screen 'Edit exercise'
user_sees: The saved values; 'How you log it' locked when sets exist
must_not: Log type changeable so old sets turn wrong

user_sees: Back on the page with the new muscle
must_not: Old sets deleted or moved to another exercise

user_sees: 'Nothing hidden' — 'Every exercise shows in your lists.'
must_not: A skeleton that never ends

start: Member adds a photo or video to an own exercise

user_sees: The picture on the exercise
must_not: A too-large video saved silently ('That video is too large. Pick a shorter one.' must show)

steps.action: Gym staff open the member in the panel
user_sees: No own-exercise photos or videos
must_not: Member's exercise media shown to the gym or other members
